nom: Exuviance Anti-Aging Radiance Face Serum with PHAs

avis.texte: I got this as a sample & have used it 3 times. I have to say, I'm honestly impressed. It's improved my fine lines/tightened my skin up a bit & made my skin more radiant & bright. I get a lot of face serum samples & haven't found a serum I'd be willing to spend money on, but this one... this one I might buy.

I have bot only noticed the advantages to my skin routine but others around me have as well. Glowing, Refreshed skin keeps me looking youthful. Results came with consistency in daily routine. Age spots or blemishes faded away. If price is not a concern, I would highly recommend this Brand and this serum specifically. I am satisfied with the products offered, but I tend to purchase only when a Beauty sale or 20%off coupon.
I've loved Exuviance, but not this one. On the face it's sticky to the touch and burns my skin. The pure Citra Firm serum is the best.

avis.titre: Good for some but not for all
avis.texte: I had read great reviews and heard good word-of-mouth before trying this serum so I understand that it might be a wonder product for some but not for this dry skin, sensitive skin, eczema-prone girlie. I experienced pretty drastic dryness the first week I tried it which then became red splotches so I would say if your skin is sensitive, do a patch test first. Back to Dr Jart barrier products for now

Received a free sample. It was easy to apply with absulutely no stinging. It took hours to absorb, leaving my skin super shiny and feeling a bit greasy. Although my skin felt hydrated, I could not stand the greasy feel and washed my face after 4 hours. Skin looked a bit brighter and smoother. That said, I am unlikely to purchase due to the way that it felt on my skin.
This serum is so nice goes on smooth all you need is a drop or two. Makes my skin super soft love it!!!

Hi, I have used this product for years and loved it before. It used to give me clear, bouncy, hydrated skin. The recent last two bottles I bought do not do this. It is drying and it has no effect on my skin whatsoever. This is extremely disappointing. Why do companies change what works? This has been noticeable. I am not purchasing anymore. Thank you

I had been using a different serum for my dull, fine lines and wrinkled skin, when I received a sample of this Exuviance serum. I love the way this makes my skin feel. I notice a visible difference, after only a few days.
Excellent vitamin C combination product it goes on sticky and then it's absorbed by the skin quickly

I received this as a sample, thinking okay.. yeah, another serum that probably won't work... I've used it 4 times which was about the entire amount in the small packet, but my face looks absolutely amazing. I am so glad I found this product!! I was kinda shocked by the price tag but the amount you use to how much you get is fine. It literally works so well, I cannot complain. I have Mature skin and lately my regular products haven't been giving me that glow, This serum gave me everything back! I pair it with bronzing drops and my skin has never looked better. Fine smile lines was depressing me, nothing I was using was working, I am already seeing them vanish.. Its literally a miracle ♡ I hope this review helps you. It's also helped with the dryness. This past winter has really dried my skin out, horribly. This serum is helping with that also!

avis.titre: It takes away 10 years of aging!
avis.texte: The radiance Serum makes my skin look young and fresh. I feel like it takes years off my age. If I have no time for makeup, I just use the serum to freshen my look!
My go to as my first product I put on in the morning. Love how it makes my skin feel and look.

Omg ! Im a serum junky and i have to say that from alllll the serums i have tried to give a glow to my skin, this is a winner. Im 45 years old, my skin has been slowly loosing the elasticity and the glow, but with this serum its all coming back! How ? I dont know! The only problem is that its a bit sticky. You MUST wash your hands after using this, otherwise you'll have sticky hands all day. It looks perfect under makeup and it doesn't pill . Im obsessed! And people can see the changes !

avis.titre: You have a glow about you
avis.texte: My date commented how much more radiant I looked and said I was glowing. Wow, I never heard that before. I am 61!

I have been using this serum for 23 years. My skin does not feel good if I skip using it for few days, I notice how dull and dry my skin is without it. Definitely it's working very well for my mature and aging skin. It gives my skin a glow and tight texture.

Actually makes my skin GLOW! Very pale. Very combination skin. Very allergic to everything. This is my holy grail for healthy looking vibrant skin. Its a thicker serum so you need to give it time to dry but i does layer well even w/ makeup!

This was sent to me complimentary of Influenster. I absolutely love this serum as it provides a soft silky radiant base for the rest of my routine. 2 pumps with my day and night skin care routines. very much exceeds my expectations!
The radiance serum leaves my skin feeling refreshed and energized in the morning. I usually add this serum to some moisturizer and apply before bedtime. Skin looks and feels more "bouncy"!

It's one of the best performing serums I've eever used. Usually my skin gets "accustomed " to a serum by the end of the second month of using it and my skin looks like I'm not using anything on it. I've not had this happen with this serum. It give my skin a glow, my pores are smaller and my skin is firmer. Ive been using this for 2 years and will continue to purchase it.
Love this serum! I've been using for a few years and it really makes a difference in my skin. Smoother and more luminous.
This product makes a noticeable difference in my skin. When I have run out or tried another product I notice my skin not looking as smooth

avis.titre: I can't even believe how amazing ￼
avis.texte: I have mild rosacea, and this stuff has been a godsend. I've tried everything out there, and nothing actually healed. This stuff has healed my skin, gotten rid of fine lines, probably taken off at least 10 years, and makes my make up glow!!! I am 48 years old and this stuff provides a barrier so that my make up does not settle on to my face and stays looking perfectly satin all day. It acts as a primer under makeup and provides a totally flawless finish that stays put all day.

I love this serum so far! I've used the same serum from another prestige cosmetics company for many years now and have not seen the same results that I get from Radiance. My skin seems to glow after using it. My pores seem smaller. I want to give it a full 6 months of use, but I am a believer so far!
Good. I havent used it long enough for 4 or 5 stars. Easy to use, so far no breakouts. Only using at bedtime

Admittedly, I have very few fine lines and my skin is (so far) aging gracefully. I don't deal with particularly dry, oily or acne prone skin. My skin is pretty even-keeled overall so I often see visible differences from skincare products. What I can say about Radiance Serum is that I love how it feels on my skin and it is an elegant formula. It's a thicker Serum that leaves a slightly tacky finish. It sinks in pretty quickly and it has been my go-to morning serum (along with an antioxidant essence & vitamin C) for going on four months. I've used it daily and I'm just now getting to my second bottle, so a little goes a long way (1 pump all over face and partially down neck). It smells pleasant but not overbearing. Like I said, I can't speak to any noticeable changes personally because my skin was at a good place when I began using it. One thing of note is that I used to get dry patches around my nose during the windy spring season and dry, cold winter but I haven't experienced such dryness at all since starting this serum. It's a staple and I'll continue to use it indefinitely.

I put on IS clinical moisture emulsion then this radiant serum and skin is like glass. Amazing as a primer that actively works on skin. Never clogs poors and skin has improved so much! I use it Morning and night. Im obsessed

This stuff is so good! If you love skin care, and don't mind spending a pretty penny this stuff is for you! My face has never looked so hydrated and glowy ever in my life! I'm so glad I found this product.

Changes your skin after the first use! Sinks into your skin your face feel smooth and ready for a light moisturizer and you're done! I'll use a little bit of bare minerals on top of it and I'm good to go no more foundation for me buy this!

I got this serum as a free gift with purchase of other Exuviance product about six months ago, and it has been a game changer! I use it every night after washing my face. It feels slightly tacky but I follow it with Overnight Transformation Complex and my skin feels amazing after. Prior to using this serum my skin had grown dull and blah. I was trying different blushes and highlighters to look alive, but none were quite right for me. This serum really lives up to its name! My face is so radiant and my color is so pretty with it that I quit wearing blush and just rock bare skin now. I will absolutely fork out the money for another bottle when this one is empty! I use one or two pumps at a time, and I've gone through about half a bottle in six months. It lasts a long time; totally worth the money.

I'm a longtime customer of Exuvience. This serum has worked well for me until the last purchase. I have the previous almost empty bottle at home and compared the two. The color and consistency has changed from golden and thicker to clear and very light. It doesn't work for me anymore and leaves me dry during the day, making my makeup look bad. It use to blend well with my foundations, but now it's like wearing nothing. Not at all worth the money anymore and very disappointed with the obvious change. Not ok to charge the same amount for a worse product.
Great product, delivers exactly what it promises. Product consistency is superb and silky.
This is my third bottle. It's pricey but lasts a good length of time. Helps a little with fine lines.
This feels like a drink of water for my skin. You don't need much,I live in high desert climate, and this was what was missing from my life the last decade
Love this serum, I already notice improvement in texture and moisture after one week of use.

avis.titre: My face new serum for aging and oily skin
avis.texte: My favorite new serum! This serum sinks nicely into my skin, and I'm able to apply the age rebuild moisturizer on top, followed by my makeup regimen minutes later. I've been using a different brand's serum for the past several years and noticed a difference as soon as I switched to this serum. Love it for both day and evening treatment. Not sticky at all, like other serums from other brands. Thank you Exuviance!
This serum is wonderful! When you apply it, it looks like your face drank a glass of water!
It's amazing, my skin looks so illuminated and radiant!!! I love it 😍

avis.titre: Radiance Serum is a game changer!
avis.texte: This serum is a miracle worker! I have seen a dramatic change in the look and feel of my skin. Dark spots have faded and the texture of my skin is buttery soft!
I literally cannot stop looking at my face with this product. It feels so good. Works. A product worth every penny.
It gets sticky but I like it because it keeps everything TIGHT!

This product was half off so I figured I'd try it. I love it!! Results were almost immediate. My skin looks much younger and has a radiance. I also really like that it can be put on first thing after washing, and serums/moisturizer afterward. It is of course very pricy but I use two pumps per use and it looks like it'll last a long time. Plus, how much are you spending on all those other skincare products?

This is an excellent serum! It has evened out my skin tone and makes my skin feel so smooth. I use it on a clean face morning and night and follow with a moisturizer. It preps my skin well for makeup too!I will definitely keep this as part of my skincare routine!

I have been using this product for about three weeks and super happy with the results. This line is a splurge but worth the money. It is simple to use and brings multiple positive results. My skins is literally radiant… my dark spots have faded, my pores are smaller, I haven't had any breakouts since using, my skin is plumper and overall looks really healthy. I use the entire line but since adding this my skin has a lovely glow! Very happy with this product.
I use this with the sunscreen and apply my makes. My skin looks amazing.

I purchased this serum after receiving a sample to try. I have been looking for a new serum for my skincare routine as my other serum didn't seem very effective. Purchased this serum four days ago, and I have been using it for three days (only in the morning). I noticed sensitivity on the second day when I was taking a hot bath. I have noticed some other sensitivity, like when I put my sunscreen on and when I washed my face. Right now I am sitting with a fan on my face to keep it from burning. To soon to tell if it is effective, but I think I will drop down to using it once or twice a week and slowly build up use from there.
Ive been using this product for at least 18 years love what it does for my skin . And a noticeable difference when i dont use ..

avis.titre: New to me and I like it!!
avis.texte: A Rep recommended this at their store event. I'm older and my facial skin is not happy...I use this at night after using the cream cleanser and toner. My skin looked better the next morning after first use. I was actually shocked. It is improving the texture and redness.

avis.titre: This makes my skin feel great
avis.texte: This product makes my face feel dewy and hydrated. My skin feels plumper.

Exuviance is a brand that I am loyal to, quality products. This serum is a staple for me, I have purchased this many times! It soaks in and dries quickly, no sticky feeling to it after 30 seconds or so.

I have been using The Radiance Serum for almost 2 years now and my skin is in excellent condition. My Aesthetician remarks on what great skin I have for my age. I owe a big part of it to this serum...It is remarkable. Love the neck cream too! Excellent products.

avis.titre: My skin has an Amazing glow with the Radiance Serum!
avis.texte: I love the radiance serum. I use it in the am under my makeup and it makes my skin so Dewey and radiant! I also use it at night and I can truly see a difference in the appearance of my skin. It is on my must have list for sure. Thank you Exuviance for another awesome product.
It's perfect, not too oily and hydrates your skin perfectly. I love it!

I have rosacea and used this it was working at first but the I noticed it made me skins peel like dead skin any time I put moisturizer on top and made me look very shiny. I think it's great if you don't have sensitive skin! It also has a fragrance so heads up
I have recently had some kind of allergic reaction on my face. This has helped to soothe and rehydrate. Can't wait to see what it will do under normal conditions!

I found this extremely sticky which I love for under makeup. I didn't think it would be much different from other HA serums but this packs a punch and a little goes a long way. I have quite sensitive and oily skin and this works very well for me.
This product works within days, my skin looks so firm, soft and glowing. I'm such a huge dan of Retinol this is a must have, I use it morning night. My skin looks amazing

avis.titre: Fend off cold-weather dryness and dehydration
avis.texte: Fend off cold-weather dryness and dehydration with this intensely hydrating Hyaluronic Acid. I love that this serum helps with seven signs of photoaging, including loss of firmness, dullness, rough texture, lines and wrinkles, enlarged pores, and uneven skin tone. Just what my winter skin needs

I used to not really use serums because I didn't quite know the benefits of doing so. I actually really enjoy this product and it feels very luxurious all the way from the packaging to the ingredients. The product is a bit pricy so if serums aren't your thing I don't that I would choose this specific product from them to start with. I do really enjoy the serums, especially put together with other products of theirs for a skin care routine. There is somewhat of a scent, but nothing too crazy or unbearable. Everything about it just feels and looks great! Gives tour skin some radiance and life back! I have sensitive skin and I had no issues using this serum!

What an awesome serum! I have incorporated this product into my daily routine for the last month & have found myself really liking it. I've noticed some of my darker spots (like acne scars/sun spots) clearing up. It is rather expensive, but a little goes a long way. It dries quickly & doesn't leave my skin feeling tacky. I'm not a huge fan of the way it smells, but I have found it doesn't linger very long, if at all. I have worn this even without make up on, & my face is soft & glowing all day. Although this product is a serum only, I do find that my skin feels extra moisturized with it on. I would recommend this product to any of my friends; at least give it a spin & see if it works for you! I will be repurchasing in the future.
i love using this every morning and at night before treatment and moisturizer. it goes on smoothly without irritating my skin and leaves my skin with a gorgeous glow and smooth even texture and tone.
great product! thanks Influenster for sending this!! I'm always looking for new skin care products, and am happy to have been able to try this!
I love this serum. It makes my skin feel amazing! I've been getting into more skincare lately and taking care of my skin. Definitely a must!!!

I had been searching for daily skincare products and I have found them! I love this serum. Is is gentle and blends into the skin perfectly. I have noticed my skin is more soft and bright after using this for a couple week. It doesn't have a bad smell either.
This serum is so great! It's a lightweight formula with a great smell! I love putting it on before bed and waking up to a gorgeous complexion.
It's great! I saw a difference in my skin texture. I would define you buy this again.

I really wanted this to be my new favorite but I'm a little bummed at how sticky it leaves me feeling. I've needed a new moisturizing oil for a while but not sure this is the one. It does feel a lot better after putting a moisturizer over it, but I'm not usually a two step kind of person hahaha. Overall it was a good product I'm just not a super fan of it.

I use this product every other night after cleaning and toning. This product after consistent use noticeably evens out my skin tone and helps acne spots improve without as much residual hyperpigmentation. I really noticed my texture even out and helped my makeup look flawless!!
best product I've used in a long time. I've noticed my skin looks so much youthful after using this. I cannot get enough compliments ever since I've starting using this serum.
This is great for night time use. This made my skin feel very moisturized and radiant. I loved the packaging. I highly do not recommend this for the day because it made my skin extremely oily.
I like this serum. I've been using it for a week now and I hope the properties actually works to clear up my marks. My skin feels amazing when I use this and I seem to wake up with a glow.

This has been a simple step in skincare for me. After I wash my face at night and first thing in the morning, I quickly apply the serum. My usually dry, dull winter skin has come to life-adding a bit of a glow and evening out my skin tone.
Loving this serum so far! I haven't noticed a huge difference but it's super moisturizing and feels great before bed!
Soft and lightweight serum. Went onto my skin nicely. Easy to use pump bottle which I liked quite a lot. Having seen a difference to my skin, but have only been using it a week.

The first couple times I used the sirum I didn't like the way it felt. it kind of has a tacky oil feeling at first and feels like it just sits on the surface of the skin. however once I got used to that feeling I did notice a nice change in texture! I had a few bumps along my jaw that are slowly going away. altogether a pretty nice product!
+made skin hydrated, smooth and glowy +great for dry, normal, sensitive and oily skin types +sticky residue, so better for evening routine and not before makeup

Im someone who likes to know whats in what im putting on my skin. There were good ingredients but there were some bad ones too. Unfortunately companies take the easy route and use cheap ingredients that are banned in the EU and a few other countries and this one is no exception to being made the cheap way.

Another great product. One pump and my face is good. Make sure your take some time to run it in or let it settle into your skin. I love that it feels so amazing on my face. I would definitely recommend this to others!
I loved this moisturizing serum because it didn't irritate my skin at all and was actually soothing. It layers well with other products!
This product just glides on the skin yet it's very absorbing. It's a bit pricey but definitely worth every penny.

I received this product for my honest review. It is very hydrating and doesn't leave a sticky feeling. It doesn't have a smell so that's great as well. I am a first time user so it's hard to compare to any other serums.
I bought the Serum month ago, and I am seeing the incredible results on my face.

This radiance serum visibly improves seven signs of photoaging including to loss of firmness, dullness, rough texture, lines, wrinkles, enlarged pores and uneven skin tone. I have been using for three weeks and love this serum. I really like the ingredients and the green packaging of this serum. It quickly absorbs into my skin. It is not sticky. It has a scent that is not overpowering. It gave my skin a beautiful glow, made my skin look smoother, reduced my redness and pores.

This product is my new holy grail. My skin has been so dry and brittle this winter living in the northeast and with the combination of the products my skin has gotten so soft and you would never believe it's 10 degrees outside.
this bottle has lasted me quite a while, as the material inside is fairly spreadable and a small amount goes a long way. it's slightly sticky yet not too thin, so it's still spreadable
At first the serum made my skin feel greasy but over time my skin built up a tolerance to it and there wasn't an issue anymore. I love it and it's improved my overall skin quality

I received this Radiance Serum from Exuviance in exchange for my honest review. I've been loving this Serum as it contains some very beneficial ingredients like Vitamins A (Retinol), C, & E as well as Marine Botanicals to give my skin a beautiful glow and radiant complexion. I do have to say it's quite thick so if you don't like that, then I'd advise you to mix it into your moisturizer or use this after using a Peel like Exuviance's Retinol Peel. They work fabulously together and when paired like this, it doesn't feel heavy on the skin. I love this serum in my night routine, and it works very well if you don't layer any serums under or over it!
leaves skin soft without feeling sticky , also has a light herbal scent. overall love the product and will continue using it

I loved how hydrating and nourishing the seruma was. It left my skin glowing, and it felt moisturized all day. You could tell that there were high-quality ingredients used in this product. I would definitely recommend.￼

This amazing antiaging serum energize dull, stressed skin, boosting youthful radiance right on first use and it get more and more visible results each time, applying on the morning and before sleep. The serum is easy spreading and quickly absorbed by the skin: great hydration for all skin types and non comedogenic for oily or combined skin like mine. I didn't feel any need to apply another hydrating cream after it (oily skin). The serum improve 7 signs of photoaging including loss of firmness, dullness, rough texture, lines and wrinkles, enlarged pores and uneven skin tone. Radiance Duo from Exuviance - Pure Retinol Correcting Peel & Radiance Serum Yes, I'm in love for this duo: my skin is rejuvenating a lot! The peeling and the multi task serum together made my pores shrink and clean without break outs and diminished the acne and other marks as well. Bonus: they're perfect for neck area too and the serum is perfect as a primer for makeup.
This serum was light yet very moisturizing. It was not a thick serum which was nice.

This serum has been very effective for me, however I have oily skin and it does make me a bit oilier. To avoid the oil during the day, it has been working well at night, and I just use the serum, no moisturizer on top.

I don't hate this serum but I also don't love it. I don't feel like it was beneficial to my complexion at all. It does apply as a serum but had a very tacky feeling and took a while to absorb. My face maintained hydration so that's a positive.

I love the ingredients in this serum. My skin has never been more smooth. I've always had issues with texture on my chin and forehead but using this serum regularly has made my skin smoother than ever. It's become a staple in my night time skin care routine. It does have AHA's so if you try it remember to wear your sunscreen for protection.

avis.titre: good but I would never buy
avis.texte: So I had never heard of this product and I do get nervous to try new products on my skin. I naturally looked up this product. While the reviews were great I just can't be spending so much money on a product that didn't absolutely wow me

I tend towards serum over moisturizers because they soak into my skin well, and I feel like they are easy to layer with make up. This is definitely on the heavy side for a serum, but it's very moisturizing. The texture is great and distributes well. ￼

avis.titre: so far so good, but sticky
avis.texte: Not a huge fan of the texture of this serum, the scent is light but as an oil and application, it leaves a bit of a sticky residue/layer on your face

I enjoyed the scent and benefits of this product. It did not irritate my skin, but it did leave a sticky residue that was unpleasant. I have other favorite vitamin c serums that I'll stick with! Worth trying out though!
I really like this serum! It's really light and not too fragrant. I feel like it's lasted a long time and I've definitely felt my skin getting softer!
A lovely, lightweight skincare serum that makes a visible difference in the brightness and evenness of my skin!

It can be hard to tell whether serums or lots of products even do anything. Fortunately (?) before starting these products I had noticed my skin was looking dull, dry. This serum is easy to put on, feels light, and I feel my skin looks more soft and hydrated. Better than other skin care lines? Idk but will continue using it
I definitely see a difference on my skin after using it. The formula itself isn't to greasy. The pump gives you the right amount to use.

avis.titre: Would have loved it but why does it smell like dis
avis.texte: This serum is superb. I love every bit of it. It gave me really clear skin, but I have one complaint. why does it smell like dish soap. The whole time while I applied it, it smelled like Dawn soap. Otherwise this product is great. it's slightly sticky, but that didn't bother me. I will not buy it again just because it has that dish soap smell.

My skin is brighter after using this serum. It gave me a beautiful glow. The rough texture and wrinkles on my skin improved. I used it twice a day on my face and neck. It can be used alone or before a moisturizer. You can also use it as a primer. Use with sunscreen since it contains Alpha Hydroxy Acid. I recommend it.

avis.titre: great as far as serums go
avis.texte: I have been using this product a few weeks. Obviously hard to notice any change in such a short time. The pros though are that it dries quickly and doesn't feel tacky like some serums do. It is very moisturizing for the eye area which a lot of people need as they age. Will continue to use.

This serum in combination of other provides products worked really well. It provided moisture throughout the day and kept it locked in. Definitely felt like it worked better with all the products combined but since it was a limited number of product that I could use as a combo, it felt lacking without them.
I love have radiant this serum makes my skin look. However between it and the other products in the box I'm not sure which one broke me out a little so I won't give it all the stars.

I received this product complimentary in exchange for honest review. I absolutely LOVE the Radiance Serum. A little goes a long way and it absorbs quickly into the skin. It does not leave a greasy residue at all, but slightly tacky which is nice under makeup or a moisturizer. I feel that my skin looks overall more even and hydrated after using this serum for four weeks.

I love how nice & bright my skin is after just a few weeks of use. I use a pea sized amount which works wonders! I love to use it as a primer before applying cc cream. It's a great product with great results!

avis.titre: Gentle exfoliant with a nice experience
avis.texte: I've been using this product a couple times a week interchangeably with my holy-grail exfoliator (Paula's Choice 2% BHA) for a little over a month, and I've really enjoyed it! As a PHA product it's a bit more gentle and it feels nice on the skin.
I was provided this serum to try as part of the campaign and let me just say it had been amazing for my sensitive skin!

Feels great on the skin! I don't have sensitive skin so this product worked for me. it makes my skin feel so smooth and moisturized. i would recommend this product for anyone who is looking for a great serum.

This serum really made my skin glow. I love how soft it made my skin and it didn't feel sticky or greasy. The packaging was pretty plain, but functional. The smell wasn't the best, but also wasn't terrible. I feel pretty neutral about the look/small.
I love the smell of this product and the bottle. I think it did work some but I did not notice a huge difference on my skin. My skin did look great right after putting on.
I didn't mind this product but I didn't see or notice a difference. Didn't make me break out but will return to my old skin care zo skin healtg
I felt like this serum helped my face feel better from the crazy Texas cold and hot weather my make up also looked good on top of the serum

This serum is very lightweight but carries a lot of positive properties! Anytime I wear this I feel like my skin is very glowy and do Dewey!￼￼￼ I have super sensitive skin and this did not irritate me at all. I would purchase this again. ￼

I have received this product in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this serum for about three weeks now. I am very impressed with it. I only have to use one pump for my face. It keeps my face super hydrated and feeling good. It is smooth and not sticky.
One week in & feel as if my skin is healthy & shiny. Has a slight sticky once applied but skin absorbed it well. Glowing for sure!
